messages.author: d12379035be5c6f9
messages.subject: ctmm error
parts:
Hola,

I am running akde for Andean Condor. I am gettin this error:

paway<-paway[[1]]
> GUESS <- ctmm.guess(paway, interactive=F)
Error in data$t : $ operator is invalid for atomic vectors
> vg.paway<-variogram(paway)
Error in data$t : $ operator is invalid for atomic vectors

The data is in movebank format.

Any input? Thanks in advance.

All the best,

Adrian

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: ctmm error
parts:
Hi Adrian,

My blind guess is that you imported one animal, making paway initially one telemetry object (and not in a list of multiple telemetry objects) and then paway[[1]] becomes its first data.frame column, which would then give that type of error when trying to extract slot "t" from an array without slots.

But if that's not it, you can message/email me the data and I can take a look.

Best,
Chris
